final: SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_film_actor_records, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_above_mean, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt - avg_excess) AS avg_above_excess_mean FROM (SELECT film_id, cnt, avg_cnt FROM (SELECT film_id, cnt, AVG(cnt) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM (SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS cnt FROM film f LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id)) WHERE cnt > avg_cnt) AS step3 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM (SELECT cnt, AVG(cnt) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM (SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS cnt FROM film f LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id) WHERE cnt > avg_cnt)) AS step4 WHERE cnt > avg_cnt + avg_excess
